title: The Text Typing WordPress plugin before 2.2.2 does not properly sanitize and escape a block attribute before storing…
description: The Text Typing WordPress plugin versions before 2.2.2 contain a vulnerability where a block attribute is not properly sanitized and escaped before storage and output. This flaw allows users with Contributor role or higher to inject stored cross-site scripting (XSS) payloads that execute in the browsers of visitors to affected pages.
